doormen/30596.htm.text: Partisan Doorman: Although the war is over, the dispute over the border has yet to be resolved. Keep your head down for now.

doormen/30596-busy.htm.text: Oh! Our castle is being attacked and I can't do anything for you right now.

doormen/30596-no.htm.text: Hey! Who's there? Don't even think about bothering Harkel! Now be gone before I get angry!
